struct Node {

};

int gcd(int x, int y) {
    if (y == 0) return x;
    else return gcd(y, x % y);
}

long long mod_pow(long long a, long long b, long long mod) {
    a %= mod;
    if (b == 0) return 1 % mod;
    if (b & 1) return (a * mod_pow(a, b - 1, mod)) % mod;
    else {
        long long u = mod_pow(a, b >> 1, mod);
        return (u * u) % mod;
    }
}

long long _pow(long long a, long long b) {
    if (b == 0) return 1;
    if (b & 1) return a * _pow(a, b - 1);
    else {
        long long u = _pow(a, b >> 1);
        return u * u;
    }
}

int modInv(int a, int m) {
    if (gcd(a, m) != 1) return -999;
    else return (a % m + m) % m;
}

bool isPowerOfTwo(int x) {
    return x != 0 && ((x & (x - 1)) == 0);
}

bool isprime(int x) {
    if (x < 2) return false;
    for (int i = 2; i <= (int)std::sqrt(x); i++) {
        if (x % i == 0) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

static bool prime[1000007];
static const int INT_MAX = 1000007;

void sieve() {
    std::fill(prime, prime + INT_MAX, true);
    prime[0] = prime[1] = false;
    for (int i = 2; i * i < INT_MAX; i++) {
        if (prime[i]) {
            for (int j = i * 2; j < INT_MAX; j += i) {
                prime[j] = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, w;
    cin >> n >> w;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cin >> a[i];

    int e = 0, o = 0;
    deque<int> stack;
    stack.push_back(a[0]);
    vector<int> cuts;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) ++e;
        else ++o;
        if (e == o) {
            cuts.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    int size_cuts = (int)cuts.size();
    vector<vector<int>> dp(size_cuts + 1, vector<int>(w + 1, 0));

    for (int i = 1; i <= size_cuts; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= w; j++) {
            if (cuts[i - 1] <= j) {
                dp[i][j] = max(1 + dp[i - 1][j - cuts[i - 1]], dp[i - 1][j]);
            } else {

            }
        }
    }

    cout << dp[size_cuts][w] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
